Name: Pamtrailer - Content Patcher
Author: vegolasify
Description:
This is a Content Patcher map edit where the only change is the appearance of Pam's trailer! It is my first mod and I am really happy with how it turned out!
I hope this mod makes you laugh because it truly is a beautiful monstrosity xD

UPDATE:

Version 1.0.2 only applies changes to the intended buildings. The older versions mistakenly kept the vanilla town buildings and are not compatible with other retextures!

Downloads.Description: Updated so the mod only overwrites the intended buildings!
